title: Creamy Yellow Dutch Bake
description: A rich and creamy bake made with a blend of yellow and Dutch cheeses, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: Bake
ingredients.notes: A pre-made bake or a sheet pan

instructions: Melt the butter and spread it evenly over the bake.
Grate the yellow and Dutch cheese.
Mix the grated cheese together, then distribute it evenly over the bake.
Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Check the bake and adjust the cooking time as needed.
